description: This file defines an enumeration MessageHeaderDefinition for well-known message headers in the Eclipse Ditto project, including their keys, types, validators, and external header handling policies.

classes.name: MessageHeaderDefinition
classes.description: Enumeration implementing HeaderDefinition, representing well-known message header definitions with associated metadata and validation logic.

methods.name: forKey
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a MessageHeaderDefinition based on a header key.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java class type of the header value.

methods.name: getSerializationType
methods.description: Returns the class type used for serialization.

methods.name: shouldReadFromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates if the header should be read from external sources.

methods.name: shouldWriteToExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates if the header should be written to external sources.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the header value using the associated validator.
